description_full:
✨ START YOUR CAREER JOURNEY WITH PT KCG! ✨

Ready to gain real-world experience and take your first step into the professional world?

PT Kurnia Ciptamoda Gemilang (PT KCG) is opening opportunities for a PAID INTERNSHIP PROGRAM! 🚀

💼 Paid Internship
📅 Start From: November 2026
⏳ Duration: 6 Months
🌱 Hands-on Experience & Professional Growth

Join PT KCG and get the opportunity to learn, contribute, collaborate with professionals, and develop valuable skills in a dynamic work environment.
Your internship can be more than just a learning experience it can be the beginning of your career journey.

📩 Ready to grow with PT KCG? Apply now!

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
